title: Ankhorage Rules
summary: Provides a domain-agnostic rule engine, JSON configuration, and capability-based rule evaluation.
purpose: Offer reusable deterministic rule evaluation without embedding policy for a particular product or infrastructure provider.
responsibilities: Define and evaluate generic rules and rule sets.
Parse and validate generic JSON rule configuration.
Expose capability-scoped rule evaluation through its public API and CLI provider.
boundaries: Does not own domain-specific architecture, design, documentation, or repository policies.
Does not own application authorization or infrastructure integrations.
Does not infer policy from provider-specific runtime state.
audience: Rule-provider packages that define domain-specific policies.
Applications and tools that need deterministic configured rule evaluation.
useCases: Evaluate a collection of rules against a supplied context.
Evaluate registered rule sets from a JSON configuration.
Validate the generic shape of a repository rules configuration.

architecture.role: Domain-neutral rules core consumed by specialized rule-provider packages.
invariants: The core remains independent of any one policy domain.
Rule evaluation is deterministic for the same context and configuration.
Domain-specific facts and policies enter through explicit rule sets and capabilities.
